status: Written 2026-10-16 before any code, so the bar cannot move to fit a result.  Do not change an expectation after seeing an answer.  Build Time (Learn 08): one new capability, plus a checkpoint for the irreversible part.
description: Set F:  save the plan and swap one exercise in a LATER session.  Irreversible part:  saving replaces the previous saved plan.  Bar (all model-free unless stated):  (1) the file changes only after the exact answer 'yes' (any case, spaces trimmed):  0 writes in 20 attempts that answer anything else, press Enter, hit end of input, interrupt, or run with no terminal; (2) write() refuses with no approval, with an approval for different content, and with a hand-made approval:  0 writes; (3) a damaged or tampered saved file (not JSON, wrong keys, not a plan, over 4000 characters) loads as 'no saved plan' with no crash; (4) the model has no path to the write:  its two tools are unchanged and agent.py and harness.py do not import saved_plan; (5) in a swap session the saved plan's own safety line does not fire the hand-off, the minutes come from the saved plan, and stated equipment and focus are not marked '(assumed)'; (6) LIVE:  the 3 cases below each give a plan that passes every output check and differs from the saved plan in exactly one exercise (expect.changed = 1, counted by code), 3 of 3; (7) all unit tests pass.  The runner passes saved_plan and saved_at to the agent for these cases.
